artifacts.summary: Verifies the landed territory/handoff work and characterizes the two remaining gaps: watcher/monitor teardown missing from wrap-up.md, and a missing base-mode territory decision record plus stale territory.md scope framing.

memory_candidates.content: This codebase has an established inline 'decision record' idiom for base-vs-hard engine asymmetries: a **Decision record**:/**Asymmetry decision (recorded...)**: prose block placed directly in the governing SKILL.md near the relevant mechanism, explicitly noting when the two /orchestrate engines deliberately diverge and why, 'so both engines visibly agree.' See skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md lines 244-260 (loop-guard-staleness asymmetry) for the reusable template. There is no separate ADR/decisions directory in this repo -- decision records live inline in the file whose behavior they govern.

Base mode's file_scope-collision deferral (skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md Stage MT-3, defer_ledger) only compares tasks being admitted in the CURRENT cycle against each other and against live-registered sessions' file_scope. It has no mechanism against a woken predecessor from an EARLIER cycle that already reported but is still live (self-armed watcher or operator resume) -- that case is structurally invisible to the admission-time check. Any future territory/concurrency work on base mode must address this blindness explicitly rather than citing file_scope deferral as already-sufficient.
